topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Check Point SmartConsole Improper Authentication Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Check Point SmartConsole contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to obtain an application login token and use it to authenticate with full administrative privileges.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: iCagenda Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: iCagenda contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows the upload of arbitrary files in the file attachment feature, ultimately resulting in PHP code upload and execution.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Balbooa Forms Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Balbooa Forms contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated arbitrary file upload which could allow uploading of executable files leading to full RCE.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Microsoft Exchange Server. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could attempt to impersonate any other user of the Exchange server.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Sumavision EMR Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Sumavision Enhanced Multimedia Router (EMR) contains a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability allowing the creation of users with elevated privileges as administrator on a device.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.

topMovers.product: Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance
topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Citrix ADC, Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance Information Disclosure Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Citrix ADC, Citrix Gateway, and multiple Citrix SD-WAN WANOP appliance models contain an information disclosure vulnerability.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: QNAP QTS Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: QNAP QTS contains an improper input validation vulnerability allowing remote attackers to inject code on the system.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacker to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DSL-2750B Devices Command Injection Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: D-Link DSL-2750B devices contain a command injection vulnerability that allows remote, unauthenticated command injection via the login.cgi cli parameter.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Vates Xen Orchestra Improper Validation of Specified Type of Input Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Vates Xen Orchestra contains an improper validation of specified type of input vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and perform actions with administrative privileges via a specially crafted authentication token containing an empty JSON object.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Project MONAI MONAI Label Path Traversal Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiCollab OS Command Injection Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Mitel MiCollab contains an improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command (OS command injection) vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary system commands.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Idunno AntiCsrf Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Drupal Core Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Drupal Core contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to take over a site via the exposed Drupal installer when the site is in one of the affected unusual or incomplete installation states.

highestSignals.product: Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router
highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router OS Command Injection Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root via a specially crafted salt minion ID.

Mitel MiCollab contains an XML injection vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands using pre-staged malicious content.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check that allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series Path Traversal Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to access and read underlying server system files via the XML interface.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to run arbitrary commands on the affected system.

observations: CISA added 18 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days.
Other is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (9).
Mitel has the most new KEV entries this week (5).
CVE-2026-16232 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 894 positions.
executiveSummary: CISA added 18 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Other is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (9). Mitel has the most new KEV entries this week (5). CVE-2026-16232 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 894 positions.
